source: Orphanet registry records (Research and trials, Patient registries), read 11 September 2026, and each registry's stated scope; administrative boundaries from Natural Earth 10m admin-0 and admin-1 (public domain).
note: Coverage of the registries that are coded for the conditions this site describes, outside France. The French registries are drawn département by département in registry-zones.json from the Santé publique France surveillance report. Registries with status "clinical" are not population-based: they recruit through participating hospitals rather than covering a territory, so their outline marks the country they work in and claims no coverage of the births in it. Status "hospital" marks a national system that samples births through reporting hospitals rather than covering every birth in a territory. Entries with "map": false are registries this register lists without drawing: an umbrella with no territory of its own, a hospital network, a single centre, or a national register we cite without having mapped its coverage. Status "study" marks a population-based study built on registries, listed because papers in our bibliography rest on it; it covers no territory and is not drawn. Each entry's "match" phrases are what tools/enrich-bibliography-registries.py looks for in a paper's title and abstract to record that the paper rests on the registry. "source" carries the full provenance and "source_short" a one-line citation; the map popup shows the short one, because a popup that quotes four references is unreadable and the registries page carries them in full. "since" is the year the registry itself started collecting, not the year it joined a network, and each entry's source says where the year comes from. An entry without it is one whose start year we have not sourced; the card leaves the line out rather than guessing. "label" is the registry's official title and nothing else: no city, country or operating body appended, because the area, country and kind fields carry those. "local" holds the official title in the registry's own language where that is not English.
